sources.title: Clinical evaluation of software (MDR Art. 61 / MDCG 2020-1)
sources.why: CE marking of a SaMD is not granted just because code works; MDR conformity requires documented clinical evidence.

sources.title: SaMD lifecycle standards (IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 62366-1, ISO 13485)
sources.why: These harmonised standards are how a device demonstrates conformity with MDR's General Safety & Performance Requirements for CE marking.

sources.title: SaMD Class IIa (MDR)
sources.why: Class IIa CE marking requires a Notified Body conformity assessment and ISO 13485 QMS, the core MDR conformity route.
